You’ll sort and label products and keep your work area clean and safe. You’ll work closely with your colleagues and pay close attention to the quality of the work. - At least VMBO-level education or equivalent
- 0 to 1 year of work experience in production or a warehouse

Do you enjoy working with your hands, paying attention to detail, and seeing the direct results of your work at the end of the day? Are you looking for a stable job within a modern company where your skills are appreciated and your growth matters? Look no further!

What are you going to do?
As an Operator Finishing, you play an important role in creating high-quality aluminium precision products. Your work directly contributes to the final product delivered to customers.

Your responsibilities include:

- Assembling components by screwing, bonding, and riveting
- Processing products through drilling, tapping, and bending operations
- Finishing parts by sanding and deburring
- Reading and following technical drawings
- Inspecting products for dimensions, quality, and appearance
- Identifying improvement opportunities and contributing ideas to optimise processes

What do we offer?
- Employment conditions according to the Metalektro Collective Labour Agreement
- Excellent pension scheme
- 27 vacation days
- 104 additional leave hours per year
- Opportunities for training and career growth
- Informal working atmosphere within a supportive team

Where will you work?
You'll join a company that believes great products are built by great people. That's why there's plenty of attention for personal growth, teamwork, and enjoying what you do.

What do we ask?
- Experience in assembly, mechanical fitting, or metalworking
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Dutch, English or German language skills
- Independent, accurate, and hands-on mindset

Are you interested?
Ready to make an impact and grow your career with a modern manufacturing specialist? Apply today!
